label: Vimeo
terms_note: No commercial content on Basic accounts; the user's membership tier sets file size and weekly upload quota; transcoding is asynchronous.

auth: 1. Vimeo developer app → OAuth 2.0 authorization code (scopes `public private upload edit delete interact stats
2. **Request upload access** for the app (Vimeo reviews the use case) — until granted `POST /me/videos` fails.
3. Tenant's membership tier decides file size + weekly upload quota (Free accounts are tightly limited; paid tiers

endpoints.call: POST /me/videos` {upload{approach: "tus", size}, name, description, privacy{view, embed, comments, download}, folder_uri, content_rating} → `upload.upload_link

reference.limits: - Per-app rate quota (`X-RateLimit-Limit / Remaining / Reset`, 429); transcoding is asynchronous (`transcode.status`). - Vimeo Terms: no commercial content on Basic accounts; content guidelines.

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: Vimeo personal access token (developer.vimeo.com > My Apps > your app > Generate an access token, authenticated, scopes public private edit delete interact stats) or an OAuth authorization-code token; Vimeo access tokens do not expire unless revoked. Sent as 'Authorization: bearer <token>'.

adapter.terms: API rate limits depend on the account plan and are reported in X-RateLimit-* response headers; 429 when exceeded.

me.note: GET /me returns the token's user {uri, name, link, account (plan), metadata.connections ...}.

read_comments.note: GET /videos/{video_id}/comments?page&per_page (`post_id` is the numeric video id) returns {total, page, per_page, paging, data[comment]}. A comment has no bare id field: `id` is its uri (/videos/{video_id}/comments/{comment_id}); replies are a separate connection (GET .../comments/{comment_id}/replies).

delete.note: DESTRUCTIVE: DELETE /videos/{video_id} permanently deletes the video (204; 403 when the token lacks the delete scope or does not own the video).

analytics_post.note: GET /videos/{video_id} filtered with fields= to the counts: stats.plays ('The current total number of times that the video has been played', may be null when hidden), comments and likes totals. `post_id` in the result is the video uri.

not_offered.publish_text: Vimeo has no text posts; the closest call, POST /videos/{video_id}/comments ('Add a comment to a video', https://developer.vimeo.com/api/reference/videos#create_comment), is a comment on a video, not a post.
not_offered.publish_image: Vimeo hosts videos only; there is no image post (https://developer.vimeo.com/api/reference/videos).
not_offered.reply_comment: POST /videos/{video_id}/comments/{comment_id}/replies needs the video id as well as the comment id (https://developer.vimeo.com/api/reference/videos#create_comment_reply); the reply input carries only comment_id.
not_offered.read_mentions: The API has no mentions or notifications endpoint for a user (https://developer.vimeo.com/api/reference/users).

evidence: host api.vimeo.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
spec https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vimeo/openapi/master/api.yaml: 4/4 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
auth_audit.notes: read_comments: spec says "response path items='data' is not in the response schema"; waived: Vimeo's OpenAPI models paginated collections as bare arrays; the API wraps them as {total, page, per_page, paging, data[]} (developer.vimeo.com common formats) read_comments: spec says "response path total='total' is not in the response schema"; waived: Vimeo's OpenAPI models paginated collections as bare arrays; the API wraps them as {total, page, per_page, paging, data[]} (developer.vimeo.com common formats) analytics_post: spec says "query parameter 'fields' is not defined by the spec"; waived: `fields` (JSON filter) is accepted by every Vimeo endpoint (developer.vimeo.com, JSON filter); the OpenAPI does not repeat it per operation
